finding.title: Add Goals to tool/schema_check.dart's whitelist — the profileId-in-PK Rule-0 checker silently skips it
finding.area: tool (Rule-0 checkers, wired into make ci)

evidence.quote:
///   - Completions, Goals, LearningLedger, Streaks: profile-scoped but
///     lack a composite UNIQUE/index today. DNI-323 / DNI-324 will add
- **DNI-323** — 25.2: Append-only event tables with composite-natural-key UNIQUEs *(Done)*

finding.why: schema_check.dart's own docstring says Goals is deliberately exempted from the profileId-composite-key invariant pending DNI-323/DNI-324 — but docs/planning/epics.md marks both Done, and the other 3 tables named in the same sentence (CompletionEvents, LearningLedger, StreakEvents) already HAVE their composite @TableIndex and are already in the whitelist — only Goals was never followed up. Concretely, goals.dart has a bare autoincrement id with profileId as a plain FK column (no composite key/index), and goal_dao.dart's getAllGoals() has zero profileId filter while deleteGoalsByCurriculum(curriculumId) filters only by curriculumId — which is NOT unique per profile (two child profiles can each have a track on the same curriculum, e.g. Mishnayos). `make ci` runs schema-check and reports green while this gap ships every build, giving false confidence exactly where Story 25.1 (the multi-profile-leak story that motivated this checker) says it matters most.
finding.recommendation: Add profileId to a composite uniqueKeys/@TableIndex on the Goals table (migration + schema export per DB-4), add 'Goals' to _defaultWhitelist, and correct the docstring to stop citing DNI-323/DNI-324 as pending. Separately, audit goal_dao.dart's curriculumId-only queries for cross-profile scoping (getAllGoals, deleteGoalsByCurriculum) and add profileId filters or justify their absence explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: `dart run tool/schema_check.dart` (wired into `make ci` via the `schema-check` target) fails red for Goals until it has profileId in a composite key/index, then passes green after the migration.
_defaultWhitelist includes 'Goals'; the docstring no longer references DNI-323/DNI-324 as pending work.
A regression test asserts getAllGoals()/deleteGoalsByCurriculum() cannot return/delete another profile's row when two profiles share a curriculumId.
